title: Auditt
tagline: An onramp/offramp that makes it easy for citizens of less crypto friendly regions to enter the Ethereum ecosystem.
description: This onramp/offramp combines DeFi, NFTs and traditional banking to allow citizens of less crypto-friendly regions to easily enter the Ethereum ecosystem. Users can use their credit or debit cards to exchange their fiat into crypto through the purchase of an NFT. This NFT can then be collateralized for ADTT ERC-20 tokens, to be exchanged and bridged directly from the AuDiTT platform.
how_its_made: For this project, we used a number of sponsors to piece together our MVP. We used @Covalent's NFT API for our NFT marketplace. @Filecoin is used to securely store user's KYC data needed for off-ramping. For our built-in bridge, we used @deBridge, allowing users to easy bridge to other chains directly from our platform. @Tableland is used to store NFT metadata from marketplace collections. @Livepeer allows users to live stream from the NFT marketplace. @Worldcoin is used as the KYC method for users to access the AuDiTT platform. @EPNS is integrated into the Admin section to send messages to users when their KYC is approved. @Polygon has been used for our NFT and Liquidity Pool smart contracts.
